_doc: Ledger of loop hypotheses for World 2. Status: open | running | kept | reverted | untested (closed without a result). Check before picking one; set running (commit) when you start; set the final status with the cycle number. The World 1 ledger is in archive/v1/hypotheses.json.

hypotheses.change: ENV.cold 1 -> 0.8: cold is ~60% of deaths (679 of 1103 in the last batch), so who dies is decided by winter luck. Predict less cold-death noise, so skill separates breeders better and probes.evolved rises.
hypotheses.note: probes.evolved 2637 -> 2688 (1.9%, t=0.38, no-effect); probes.learningGain -12 -> -168 (-1256.5%, t=-0.99, no-effect); probes.memoryGain 244 -> 253 (3.8%, t=0.05, no-effect); 5 replicates x 60000 ticks

hypotheses.change: ENV.thirst 1 -> 1.125 (first rung; 1.25 screened too big: pop 158 vs 208, cold 61%). Thirst is 8% of deaths, so drinking skill is barely selected; a slightly shorter drink should reward remembering water.
